verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the implementation-relevant requirement that the NFT-detail cover render completely at an appropriate size without cropping.
First concrete failure: the cover opened from the dashboard was oversized and cropped.
Target-specific implementation claim after the cropping failure: the enumerated live fix should display the complete cover on the NFT-details page.
First concrete verification of the NFT-detail sizing path: the client reports that the NFT image size is good.
Target-specific implementation claim for a distinct wallet/dashboard path: the freelancer reports a fix intended to display the token with its metadata image.

The client establishes the implementation-relevant wallet-view behavior that the NFT image must render; the added wallet context preserves the existing dashboard and NFT-detail contexts without stale or overlapping attributes.
Post-claim failure on a distinct wallet path: Rabby showed the NFT but did not render its image or information.
Regression in a distinct NFT-detail path after earlier sizing verification: the dashboard listed the NFTs, but their images disappeared when opened.
Target-specific implementation claim after the NFT-detail failure: the freelancer states that dashboard and detail images should function without XML errors after refresh.
